title: Post-Hoc Large-Sample Statistical Inference
summary: We derive inferential procedures for large sample sizes that remain valid under data-dependent significance levels (so-called "post-hoc valid inference"). Classical statistical tools require that the significance level -- the "type-I error" -- is selected prior to seeing or analyzing any data. This restriction leads to some drawbacks. For instance, if an analyst generates an inconclusive confidence interval, repeating the process with a larger significance level is not an option -- the result is final.
